text.jp: ダグザの地に帝国が誕生して１４００年余。
text.official_en:
Fourteen centuries have passed now since the
founding of our mighty Dagdan Empire.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ソレル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
今日にいたるまでの長い期間、
帝国が繁栄を続けられたことを嬉しく思う。
text.official_en:
And I can proudly declare to the world that throughout
our long and storied history, we have thrived.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イシエト

text.jp: ふっ…

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ソレル

text.jp:
ひとえに神殿を支える神官たち、
治安を守ってきた兵士たち、そして何よりも……
text.official_en:
We owe this prosperity to the priests that serve in
our temples. To the soldiers that keep the peace.
And most of all...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ソレル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: 市民たち皆のたゆまぬ努力の賜物である。
text.official_en: We owe it to you, our brave and noble citizens.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ソレル

text.jp:
戦士たちよ。己の力と技量を尽くし、
ここに素晴らしい戦いを奉納せよ！
text.official_en:
Bold warriors! Draw now upon your strength.
Hold fast to the devotion in your beating hearts.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ソレル

text.jp: 最後まで舞台に残った者には、
text.official_en: For those who stand upon the final stage...

text.jp:
そのあらゆる願いを聞き届けることを
神威法王の名において、
text.official_en:
I shall grant whatever wish you may desire.
So say I, the Divine Sovereign.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ソレル

text.jp: 約束しよう。

今、私は、
ダグシオン大剣闘祭の開幕をここに宣言する！
text.official_en:
People of Dagsion! Hear me now as I declare
that the Heroic Games...have begun!

A perfect start to these most sacred games!

誰だって？

本当に白髪鬼とやり合えるくらい強いのか？

I mean, sure, he's big, but the
White-Maned Demon is a legend.
